priorityList: Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown, ideally when energy is low and not capped.
Use Berserk (or Incarnation: King of the Jungle) as your primary offensive cooldown, preferably paired with Tiger's Fury.
Use Feral Frenzy (or Frantic Frenzy) if you have 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Cast Convoke the Spirits while Tiger's Fury is active and you have 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Cast Ravage (via the Chomp/Ravage proc) whenever the buff is active.
Use Ferocious Bite immediately if Apex Predator's Craving procs.
At 5 Combo Points, cast Rip if the bleed is missing or has less than 4 seconds remaining.
At 5 Combo Points, cast Ferocious Bite as your primary finisher.
Maintain Rake on your target, refreshing it when it has less than 4 seconds remaining or if you are in Stealth/Shadowmeld.
Maintain Moonfire on the target if you have the Lunar Inspiration talent.
Use Shred as your primary builder to generate Combo Points.
Use Shadowmeld (if Night Elf) to access a stealth-buffed Rake application when the current Rake is weak or expiring.
Cast Regrowth when Predatory Swiftness is active to avoid wasting the proc.
Use any active DPS trinkets during Berserk or Tiger's Fury windows for maximum benefit.
